question: What is the length of the hyperloop test track launched by IIT Madras in 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**422 m**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IIT Madras** launched its **Hyperloop Test Track** in **2025**.
 
• The length of the test track is **422 meters**, designed to study and develop hyperloop technologies.
 
• The hyperloop concept is a futuristic transportation system involving high-speed travel in a **vacuum tube**.
 
• **India's** first hyperloop test track was initiated by **IIT Madras**, marking significant progress in **transportation innovation**.
 
• Hyperloop systems aim to achieve speeds exceeding **1000 km/h**, making them faster than airplanes over short distances.
 
• The test track allows researchers to experiment with concepts like **magnetic levitation**, vacuum sealing, and energy efficiency.
 
• It is part of India's effort to contribute to global hyperloop research and development, strengthening its position in **cutting-edge technology**.
 
• The project aligns with India's vision of sustainable and futuristic infrastructure for enhanced connectivity and reduced carbon emissions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **10 km**__

 __
 
• Hyperloop test tracks of **10 km** are typically designed for full-scale testing but are not currently implemented by **IIT Madras**.
 
• Such test tracks have been discussed or planned by other organizations globally for demonstrating long-distance capabilities.
 
 
 
• **100 m**__
 __
 
• A **100-meter test track** is often used for initial small-scale experiments, but IIT Madras opted for a larger track to study advanced hyperloop dynamics.
 
 
 
• **1 km**__
 
 
• A **1-kilometer hyperloop track** is considered suitable for intermediate testing phases but does not match the actual length chosen by IIT Madras.
